_meta.status: Independently verified 2026-10-09 against the live provider pages and litellm 1.104.0. Per-field verdicts, URLs and quotes live in the source dataset (_meta.source_dataset), outside the repo.
_meta.units: Bytes are decimal (1 MB = 1,000,000). Providers do not say whether 'MB' means 10^6 or 2^20; decimal is the stricter reading.
_meta.field_shape: Each limit field is {value, confidence, source, scope?, base64_counted?, note?}. value null = unknown. confidence: 'verified' = the number is stated on the cited official page for this scope; 'unverified' = inferred, observed, assumed by analogy, or undocumented. source = key(s) into the top-level 'sources' map.

fields.max_images_per_request: image blocks per request (scope says if the provider counts per message or per request; Unstract sends one user message, so these are equivalent)
fields.max_request_bytes: total request body on the wire; base64_counted=true when the limit is on the JSON body that carries base64 images
fields.max_image_px: max pixels on the longer side, per image
fields.many_images_threshold / many_images_max_: Anthropic: when a request has more than threshold images, each image must be <= many_images_max_px per side

_meta.lookup_rules: See README.md in this directory ("Lookup rules"): the single statement of how a provider and model resolve to an entry.

LITELLM_ROUTE.quote: get_bedrock_route() returns 'converse' only when the base model is in litellm.bedrock_converse_models (or matches the OpenAI-family regex, or has an explicit converse/ or nova/ prefix); otherwise 'invoke'. Verifier run over all 219 bedrock/bedrock_converse vision ids (remote cost map): 212 converse, 7 invoke (anthropic.claude-mythos-preview, anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20240620-v1:0, claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0 and its 2 us-gov-* variants, ap-southeast-3/moonshotai.kimi-k2.5, invoke/anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0). Explicit claude_platform/ prefix routes to Claude Platform on AWS (direct-API limits). Unstract prefixes bedrock_mantle/ when 'bedrock_mantle/<id>' is in litellm.model_cost, or when the operator typed the prefix; an explicit bedrock/ prefix forces the classic route.

default.applies_to: unknown models, pass-through providers, and any null count/byte field after resolution
default.rationale: 20 images = the Bedrock Converse per-message limit and the point above which Anthropic tightens per-image pixels. 20 x ~0.33 MB (250 KB page, base64) = ~6.7 MB, under every documented byte limit except Gemma 4 on Mantle (3.5 MB, own entry). 20 MB = Bedrock's Claude request limit, the strictest common documented byte limit (Gemini API inline is now documented as 100 MB). Known stricter cases have their own entries (Mistral 8, Nova 2 5, Gemma 4 3.5 MB) or are noted (NIM 1.x default 5). Verifier caveats: (1) this default also fills every null count/byte field after resolution, e.g. Vertex Gemini 3.x request bytes, Azure request bytes, MiniMax and Mantle Grok/Qwen counts, so it is a hard cap on those too; (2) for pass-through providers (vLLM default 999, unknown OpenRouter upstreams) it is advisory, not a hard reject: the policy logs it and sends the request (resolve.PASS_THROUGH_DEFAULTS_ARE_ADVISORY), and an operator override file can set real values.

tokens_per_image.note: Estimate for a 150-DPI A4 page across providers (Claude/GPT ~1.5K; Gemini 3.x 1120; Nova 2 flat 230). Claude 4.7+ (high-resolution tier, ~2,850/page) has its own overrides. Used only for the warn-only context-window advisory.

bedrock.routing_note: Most bedrock/<id> vision models go through Converse, but not all: get_bedrock_route() returns 'invoke' for any id not in litellm.bedrock_converse_models (7 of 219 registry vision ids today, incl. anthropic.claude-mythos-preview and claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0) and for an explicit invoke/ prefix; an explicit claude_platform/ prefix goes to Claude Platform on AWS (direct-API limits). The Converse 20-image Message cap is therefore guaranteed only on the Converse route; on Invoke it is a conservative assumption. Models whose 'bedrock_mantle/<id>' key exists in litellm.model_cost are re-prefixed to bedrock_mantle/ and use the 'bedrock_mantle' entry; that membership depends on whether litellm loaded the remote cost map (VERIFIER_LITELLM_MAP). Look up by the VALIDATED model prefix, not get_provider() (which returns 'bedrock' for both).

max_images_per_request.note: Converse API contract, all models. Unstract sends all pages in one user message, so this is effectively per request. Verified for the Converse route only; Invoke-routed ids (see routing_note) have no AWS-documented count, so 20 is a conservative assumption there. GPT-5.6 on bedrock-runtime (us./global.openai.gpt-5.6-*) also supports Converse; its card says 100 per request 'on Amazon Bedrock', which conflicts with Converse's 20; keep 20 until probed.

many_images_max_px.note: Documented SAFE bound, not the stated limit: the page says the stricter limit is 'stated in the error message' and advises resizing to <=2000 px per side 'to stay under the limit on all platforms'. Using 2000 as a check is conservative. 150-DPI A4 pages (1240x1754) pass.

tokens_per_image.note: Derived, not stated: Claude 4.7+ is the high-resolution tier (long edge 2576 px, 4,784 visual tokens max), so a 150-DPI A4 page (1240x1754, LLMWhisperer's PDF_TO_IMAGES_DPI) is not downscaled and costs ceil(1240/28) x ceil(1754/28) = 45 x 63 = 2,835 tokens; rounded up to 2,850. The formula and tier are documented; the page size is Unstract's render. Used only for the warn-only context-window advisory.
